transcript.content: Hello. I'm glad you're here today. What brings you in to see me?

I've been having a really hard time lately because I struggle to listen when people are talking directly to me. It feels like my mind just drifts off even when I'm trying to pay attention, and it's starting to cause some real problems in my daily life.
Have you noticed these attention difficulties only recently, or is this something you've struggled with since childhood?

It has been particularly bad and challenging for the past year and nine months. However, looking back, I definitely remember struggling with my attention and focus since I was a kid, well before I was twelve.
Along with these focus issues, do you often feel restless, fidgety, or have trouble sitting still, or do you tend to act or speak impulsively?

No, I don't really experience those things. I don't feel restless or have trouble sitting still, and I wouldn't say I'm impulsive. My struggles are really just about staying focused and paying attention.
During this past year and nine months where things have been harder, have you also experienced a persistently low or sad mood, or a loss of interest in things you usually enjoy?
No, I haven't really felt down or lost interest in the things I enjoy. My struggles are really just centered around my difficulty with paying attention and staying focused.
Do you find yourself constantly worrying or feeling excessively anxious about many different things in your life, such as work, family, or everyday tasks?

No, I don't really experience constant or excessive worry or anxiety about those things. I might get a little frustrated when I lose track of conversations, but I wouldn't say I feel anxious in general.
